title: An investor's ask that names the founder is about the investor

objects.subject: Kitebird - traction metrics?
objects.body:
Hi Meera,

Good to meet you last week. Before our Monday partners' meeting, could you share your current traction metrics - clinics live, revenue run-rate and the pilot pipeline? I told the partners Meera Iyer would send a one-pager.

Thanks,
Manav Rao
Partner, Lumen Ventures
